title: Component and renderer authority
summary: The authenticated jdorfx-bsf-qualification Rasen Falcon lane is separate from Claude's actively owned rx2cpp lane. BSF4ooRexx is an optional native/Java bridge. JDORFX can support optional graphics rendering, but any Wire UI adapter must retain renderer-neutral server truth, actions, observations and resource authority.
invariants: Use authenticated Rasen Falcon rather than the read-only Alchemy sphere catalogue for coordination writes.
Do not modify rx2cpp compiler internals without its owner's coordination.
Keep JavaFX Canvas, retained nodes and animation scheduling as presentation mechanics, not semantic state.
Use immutable sources and an explicit approval gate for any production promotion.
